execute: Use case: stylized-concept. Original production 2D fantasy combat VFX flipbook, Execute Rose-Gold Edge. A 1024x1024 transparent RGBA sheet, exact invisible 4 columns x 4 rows of 256x256 cells. Effects only, no text, no characters, no UI, no backdrop. Each cell independently centered with at least 24px empty margin; NEVER draw grid, border, frame, cell outline or square shadow. Crisp painterly anime game effects, small ivory core, rose-pink edge, pale warm gold, restrained translucent glow; readable when cells reduced to 90px. Row 1 four successive frames of a small delicate blade glint building, no blade object. Row 2 four successive phases of ONE crescent slash ribbon, open C facing right, tapering ends, expanding along same single curved cut, NOT crossed slashes, NOT fire, hollow center. Row 3 four successive contact-star frames: small asymmetric four-point ivory/gold spark with a pink edge, peak at column 2, then quickly thinning, no huge flash. Row 4 four successive dissolve frames: 3-5 tiny golden/rose falling sparks, descending and fading, sparse, no smoke. Entire sheet genuine transparent background. No dark squares or cell lines. Match elegant astral-thread language of small sharp core, colored edge, very low glow and sparse sparks. New original art only.
